findings.affected_requirement: BMad Story 11.5 AC-1; spec.md FR-003, FR-004, FR-011, SC-001; plan.md line 402; research.md lines 32-33
findings.evidence: ListScopesAsync offers every visible System having at least two Repositories and every Repository within it, without consulting the accepted exact-resolution profile or current accepted relationship. AskAsync can therefore accept an arbitrary same-System pair. ChatEvidenceRetriever accepts whichever single directed exact Edge exists for that pair and validates only that ProfileFingerprint and EvidenceFingerprint are lower-case SHA-256 strings; it does not select or compare ExactCrossRepositoryEdgeEvidence.ProfileId, ProfileVersion, accepted raw profile fingerprint, accepted occurrence, aliases, refs, or commits. The green positive relational fixture proves the gap by persisting ProfileId 'august-15-prepared-profile' and ProfileVersion '1', values different from the accepted catalog values, and still asserting Found. This expands the chat beyond the prepared System/two prepared Repositories and makes an unaccepted exact relationship semantic authority.
findings.correction_outcome: Bind scope listing and retrieval to ExactResolutionProfileCatalog plus current accepted runtime evidence: require the accepted profile ID, version, raw fingerprint, exact occurrence/direction, prepared aliases, accepted refs/commits, and current ProfiledRevision identities; offer only the unique accepted prepared pair and fail missing-equivalent on any drift or non-unique match. Add relational and UI/coordinator regressions with a decoy System/pair, a decoy exact Edge, and wrong profile ID/version/fingerprint proving they are never offered or answered.

findings.affected_requirement: BMad Story 11.5 AC-2; spec.md FR-008, FR-010, SC-003, SC-005, SC-006; release-verification-contract final runtime image step 7; tasks.md T064
findings.evidence: The accepted-image Playwright positive circuit waits for .complete-answer, counts all .material-claim and .document-citation nodes, and records Validated=true when both global counts are nonzero. It never verifies that every material claim owns a citation, never operates the expandable citation control, and never asserts an authorized persisted Repository-relative locator and available Source Anchor line range. A page with multiple claims and one unrelated or empty citation wrapper would satisfy this final release check, so T064 as implemented cannot prove the mandated uninterrupted open-evidence flow or the fully cited answer it would report.
findings.correction_outcome: In the single final-image browser circuit, assert at least one citation beneath every rendered material claim, operate each citation details/summary control, and verify the expanded authorized Document citation contains a nonempty Repository-relative path and valid positive line range with lineEnd greater than or equal to lineStart. Derive Validated only from those observed assertions and add a fast harness contract test that fails when any claim is uncited or citation detail is empty/malformed.

findings.location: lines 134-138 and 196-219; src/dotnet/Vulgata.Core/DomainServices/ChatContracts.cs lines 64-103; .specify/memory/constitution.md lines 98-100; AGENTS.md line 71
findings.affected_requirement: Constitution Principle III mandatory input-validation mechanism; repository Validation rule
findings.evidence: The new user question/mode/System/Repository input path is manually validated in TryGetValidRequest and again through ad-hoc exceptions in ChatQuestionRequest.Create. There is no FluentValidation validator for this input and the Blazor UI does not use the FluentValidation validator component, although the constitution states FluentValidation is the sole input-validation mechanism and the repository rule requires it for all input. The accepted plan's narrower note about validation only if extracted does not waive the higher-authority constitution MUST.
findings.correction_outcome: Represent the chat form/request input with the repository's established DTO boundary, add a FluentValidation validator covering mode, prepared System, exactly two distinct prepared Repositories, and the normalized 1-2000-rune question, register it through the existing assembly mechanism, and use the FluentValidation component/server validation path. Retain domain invariants as defense in depth but remove manual UI validation as the authoritative input mechanism; add validator and component integration tests.
